test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence to make it grammatically correct.

This almirah is made up of __heavier __metal.
solution:
The correct option to substitute the underlined word is **'4'** i.e. **heavy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Heavier" is a comparative adjective and is used to compare two items.
 
• Since the sentence does not compare the almirah to another object, the base form "heavy" is appropriate.

The other options contain the following errors:

 
• Option 1: "Heaviest" is a superlative adjective and is used to compare more than two items.
 
• Option 2: "Most heavier" is grammatically incorrect as "heavier" is already a comparative form and does not need "most."
 
• Option 3: "Most heaviest" is grammatically incorrect as "heaviest" is already a superlative form and does not need "most."

**Correct sentence:** *This almirah is made up of heavy metal*.
